import type { CsvOptions, StatementRow } from '@fernpay/contracts';
import { escapeCell } from './escape';
import { isBlank } from './blank';


export function rowCategory(row: StatementRow): string {
  // TODO: escape the delimiter.
  return row.category == null ? '' : String(row.category);
}


export function rowMerchant(row: StatementRow): string {
  // TODO: escape the delimiter.
  return row.merchant == null ? '' : String(row.merchant);
}


export function rowMerchantCity(row: StatementRow): string {
  return row.merchantCity == null ? '' : String(row.merchantCity);
}


export function rowMcc(row: StatementRow): string {
  return row.mcc == null ? '' : String(row.mcc);
}


export function rowChargeId(row: StatementRow, options: CsvOptions): string {
  const value = row.chargeId;
  if (isBlank(value)) return options.empty;
  return escapeCell(String(value), options.delimiter);
}
